children: Enterprise IT services firm's fiscal Q2 revenue fell 4% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 beat consensus, despite declining 20% yr/yr
Company repurchased $60 mln of shares in the quarter
DXC sees Q3 FY27 revenue of ~$2.98 bln, down ~6% YoY organically
Company expects Q3 FY27 non-GAAP diluted EPS of ~$0.55
DXC forecasts FY27 revenue between $11.91 bln and $11.98 bln, down 5.5%-5.0% organically
INSURANCE SEGMENT - Insurance Software & Services revenue rose 23.1% yr/yr, helped by a favorable contract modification
AGENTIC AND AI SOLUTIONS - Co said progress with agentic and AI-based solutions expected to contribute to future growth
CORE REVENUE RECOVERY - CEO said core revenue recovery will take time, citing DXC's role in operating mission-critical systems as a differentiator for AI deployment
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for DXC Technology Company is $11.00, about 31.6% below its October 28 closing price of $16.09
The stock recently traded at 6 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 3 three months ago
